correctness.rationale: Parallel sandpile firing with 0/1 grains on outdegree-one directed cycle translates the entire firing triple by +1. Cosets of subgroup generated by pairwise differences yield exactly g=gcd(n,a,b) connected components. AP supports yield a single triangular facet at m=3, full tetrahedron boundary at m=4, and m-cycle after collapsing long-edge triangles at m>=5. For nonprogressions, three unsigned edge-difference classes are distinct, at most one antipodal, and a nonantipodal class of n free edges collapses all n translated triangles. The remaining connected graph has 2m or 3m/2 edges and m vertices per component, so wedge ranks m+1 and m/2+1 follow. Fresh exact enumeration on 1,540 normalized supports n<=30 confirmed component/rank cases. The all-n argument is combinatorial, not from enumeration.
residual_risks: Binary three-grain and parallel firing assumptions essential; no persistence or other graph topologies.
Finite supports only corroboration, not all-n homotopy proof.
